messages.content: What's the best way of ripping off a cooked shrimp's head?

Hold the shrimp’s body firmly in one hand and the head in the other.

1. Twist the head slightly clockwise or counterclockwise.  
2. Pull it away from the body in one smooth motion.  
3. If it resists, pinch just behind the head at the first shell segment and twist again rather than yanking.

Afterward, you can peel off the legs and shell starting from the head end. If you want to devein it, make a shallow slit along the back and lift out the dark vein with the tip of a knife or a toothpick.

What's the best way of ripping off a cooked shrimp's head?

Hold the shrimp’s body firmly in one hand and grip the head just behind the eyes with the other.

Twist the head slightly while pulling it away from the body—usually a short downward or sideways twist makes it come off cleanly. If it resists, pinch the shell at the neck joint first, then pull.

For less mess, do it over a bowl and use a paper towel for grip. Afterward, peel the shell starting from the legs/underside; you can leave the tail on if desired.
